name: Cudo – Protección de envíos
author: cudoecommerse

sections.description:
Cudo adds a shipping protection option to your cart or checkout. The customer chooses it (it is never pre-selected). If the package arrives damaged, gets lost or is stolen, the customer files a claim on your claims portal and Cudo compensates them.

  • You set the price: a percentage of the order, a fixed amount or price ranges.
  • Cudo deducts a fee from your Cudo balance for every protected order.
  • Works with the classic and the block-based cart and checkout.
  • Orders in Mexican pesos (MXN) with at least $500 MXN in products.

The plugin’s interface is in Spanish (Mexico), the market Cudo operates in.

You need a Cudo account: https://app.cudo.lat/register

External service

This plugin connects to Cudo (https://cudo.lat), operated by SOS Soluciones Avanzadas S. de R.L. de C.V.:

  • When you sign in and while you use the admin pages: your account, balance, prices, brand kit, claims portal, protections, claims and transactions.
  • When a customer pays an order with protection: the order number and value, the products (name, quantity, price and image) and a SHA-256 hash of the customer’s email. The name, address, phone number and plain email are never sent.
  • When you assign a tracking number or cancel the order: the tracking number or the cancellation.
  • The Brand Kit and claims portal screens preview the fonts you can choose for your portal; those previews load from Google Fonts. The plugin’s own interface font (Poppins, SIL Open Font License) is bundled.

Terms and conditions: https://www.cudo.lat/terminos-y-condiciones
Privacy notice: https://www.cudo.lat/aviso-de-privacidad
sections.installation:
1. Upload the .zip under Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and activate it.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Cudo and sign in with your Cudo account.
  3. Set your prices and turn the widget on.
sections.faq:
Where do I enter the tracking number?

In the order, under “Número de guía (Cudo)”. If you use WooCommerce Shipment Tracking or Advanced Shipment Tracking, it is taken from there.

What happens if I cancel an order?

The protection is cancelled and Cudo refunds the fee to your balance, unless 24 hours have passed since a real tracking number was assigned.

Which currencies are supported?

Only Mexican pesos (MXN). The widget stays hidden for any other currency.
sections.changelog:
0.1.1

  • Security: the SVG cleaner for brand and portal images now also removes namespaced attributes and CSS escapes.
  • The protection is no longer offered when the store is signed out of Cudo, so customers are never charged for a protection that cannot be created.
  • A retry and an order status change can no longer send the same protection twice.
  • A cancelled order that is reactivated is protected again.
  • An unexpected response from Cudo shows a retry notice instead of breaking the admin page.
  • Tested with WooCommerce 11.2.

0.1.0

  • First release.
